title: FineDeb: A Debiasing Framework for Language Models
findings: The proposed FineDeb framework significantly reduces stereotypical bias related to religion compared to other debiasing methods, achieving near-perfect scores on output-based metrics like StereoSet and Crow-S Pairs. For instance, in the Crow-S Pairs metric for religion, FineDeb achieved the best score (44.76, where 50 is ideal), outperforming the baseline BERT (62.86) and other techniques. However, this strong debiasing may distort the model's internal embeddings, leading to poorer performance on embedding-distance metrics like SEAT.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures stereotypical bias against different religious groups. This is done by evaluating language models on their preference for stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical sentences and by analyzing the associations between religious group terms and attribute words in sentence embeddings.
